long: Serious Sam: The First Encounter is a 2001 first-person shooter known for its frantic, old-school action against massive hordes of enemies. Set across ancient Egyptian environments, the player battles overwhelming swarms in wide-open arenas with a powerful arsenal. It supports cooperative multiplayer over LAN and the internet.
name: Serious Sam: The First Encounter
short: Serious Sam: The First Encounter (Croteam 2001, retail v1.05, via Proton)
